title: Confirm email address
purpose: Confirm the email address identified by a verification link.
summary: Confirm that an email address belongs to your account, from the link in a verification email.

tasks.title: Confirm the address
steps: Check the address and account shown.
Select [[Confirm]]. Opening the link alone does not verify the address.

tasks.title: Get a new link when this one has expired
steps: Select [[issue a new email confirmation request]] to open Email addresses.
Request another link there and use it within three days.

good_to_know: Opening a link for a different account signs out the account you were using.
If another account already holds this verified address, the page says Unable to confirm and nothing is recorded.
Confirming an address never creates an account or adds laboratory access.

items.label: Email address / user
items.description: Read-only address and account display name obtained from the signed link; the email is also a mailto link.

items.label: Confirm
items.description: Shown only for a valid link whose address can be verified. POSTs confirmation; merely opening the link does not verify it. Successful confirmation returns to the application/sign-in destination.

items.label: issue a new email confirmation request
items.description: Shown for invalid or expired links and opens Email Addresses, requiring sign-in if necessary. A link normally expires after three days.

items.label: Unable to confirm
items.description: Shown without Confirm when another account already holds the same verified address; no verification is recorded.

sections.title: Account boundaries
paragraphs: Opening a valid confirmation link for a different account signs out the currently signed-in account. Verifying an address does not create an account, issue laboratory roles or grant another client’s records. Public sign-up remains closed.
